details:
# Abstract

An issue with the avatar culling (Hide Beyond, Show Nearest) is that when a large group of avatars are behind you, they may take priority over the avatars in front of you which you may be speaking to. This is especially prevalent in events with large groups in small congregational spaces. Providing an optional forward cone which mirrors functionality of Earmuffs would allow prioritization of avatars in your field of vision.

# Detail

Due to the nature of the avatar culling features:

- When you use "Hide Beyond", it does not take into account where you are looking, which can result in a large amount of avatars being "shown" outside of your view in select cases, resulting in fringe performance issues despite being optically culled.

- When using "Show Nearest", likewise, when a large number of avatars have congregated behind you, in technical closer proximity than those in front of you whom you may be interacting with, those in front of you will have their avatar culled in these examples. In essence, a bunch of avatars you cannot even see are prioritized over the one you want to see and are actively speaking with. This is something I have personally experienced.

However, this could easily be fixed with an adjustable "forward cone", which shapes the field in which avatars are visible, similar to functionality found within Earmuff Mode. By implementing this, avatars behind the player can be effectively "hidden", and not counted towards the "nearby" and "in-range" avatars when using their respective culling features, reducing the amount of tuning avatar culling may need in high traffic scenarios.

title: Mirror Earmuff Forward Cone Feature with Avatar Culling
